title: Mobile App for Direct Market Access for Farmers
description: Create a mobile platform connecting farmers directly with consumers and retailers, with product listing, price negotiation, and transaction management to eliminate intermediaries.

title: AI-Driven Crop Disease Prediction and Management System
description: Develop an AI system that analyzes crop images and environmental data to predict disease outbreaks, providing actionable insights and treatment recommendations via mobile/web apps.

title: Sustainable Fertilizer Usage Optimizer for Higher Yield
description: Build a data-driven application recommending optimal fertilizer types and quantities based on soil health, crops, and weather patterns, promoting sustainable farming while enhancing yields.

title: Assured Contract Farming System for Stable Market Access
description: Develop an online marketplace facilitating contract farming agreements between farmers and buyers, with transparent communication, secure contracts, and timely payment processing.

title: AI-ML Models for Predicting Agri-Horticultural Commodity Prices
description: Create predictive models forecasting prices of pulses and vegetables using AI/ML techniques (e.g. ARIMA) to aid government decisions on buffer stock releases and market interventions.

title: Farmers Disease Diagnostic/Reporting Portal - AI-Based Mobile Portal
description: Build an AI-powered mobile portal enabling farmers to diagnose and report livestock and crop diseases, integrating with NDLM to provide diagnoses and alert veterinarians.

title: DDoS Protection System for Cloud: Architecture and Tool
description: Design cloud architecture and a tool that detects and protects against distributed denial-of-service attacks, demonstrating automatic attack detection and recovery.

title: PII Detection in Documents and Data
description: Create an application that identifies government-issued personally identifiable information embedded in documents, with detection, alerting, and optional redaction/masking of sensitive data.

title: OEM Equipment Vulnerability Web-Scraping Tool
description: Develop an automated tool that scrapes OEM websites for Critical/High severity vulnerabilities and emails vulnerability information with mitigation strategies to predefined recipients.

title: Real-Time Cyber Incident Feed Generator
description: Build a framework collecting and analyzing cyber incident activity in Indian cyberspace using machine learning, generating sector- and APT-level insights and visualizations.

title: RE-DACT: Redaction and Anonymization Tool
description: Build an NLP-based redaction tool that masks sensitive data while maintaining structural integrity, with gradational redaction levels and synthetic data generation.

title: CIS Benchmark Audit Scripts for Windows 11 and Linux
description: Develop automated audit scripts checking compliance with CIS benchmarks for Windows 11 and Linux, with GUI-based reporting and customizable organizational policies.

title: Centralized Application-Context Aware Firewall
description: Develop an endpoint firewall that identifies and restricts application access to external networks with granular domain/IP/protocol control, a central management console, and AI/ML anomaly detection.

title: Cyber Triage Tool for Digital Forensic Investigation
description: Design a forensics tool that streamlines evidence importing, automated analysis, and reporting, including RAW image scanning, IOC identification, and AI/ML-based anomaly detection.

title: Fake Social Media Account Detection
description: Build tools that identify fake profiles on Facebook, Instagram, Twitter and similar platforms, with detection, reporting, and coordination workflows for account suspension.

title: Technological Solutions for AQI Value Capturing
description: Develop mobile/alternative station solutions (potentially drone-mounted sensors) for measuring Air Quality Index and pollution parameters in real time.

title: Digital Technology for Water Footprint Calculation
description: Create an app or website that calculates water footprints for agricultural products using AI and Big Data, including camera-based scanning (similar to Google Lens) and local-language support.

title: Digital Knowledge Sharing Platform for Water Efficiency
description: Develop a wiki-style platform sharing water-efficient techniques for agriculture and conservation, with peer-reviewed articles, forums, videos, and mobile accessibility.

title: Downscaling Satellite Air Quality Maps using AI/ML
description: Develop an AI/ML model that generates fine spatial-resolution air quality maps from coarse satellite data, validated against independent ground data using Python-based ML libraries.

title: Swachhta and LiFE Dashboard with AI Image Processing
description: Develop an AI-powered dashboard monitoring cleanliness and environmental practices in post offices, with camera-based monitoring, alert generation, and centralized surveillance.

title: Virtual Herbal Garden for AYUSH Education
description: Create an interactive 3D virtual garden showcasing medicinal plants used in AYUSH systems, with interactive 3D models, plant information, multimedia content, and guided tours.

title: Queuing Models for Hospital OPDs and Bed Management
description: Develop a hospital solution managing patient queuing, bed availability, and admissions, integrating medicine dispensation and inventory management modules at city-wide scale.

title: Online Testing and Monitoring of Medicine Quality
description: Build a module for testing and monitoring medicine/consumable quality in hospitals that ensures compliance and automatically rejects low-quality supplies without manual intervention.

title: Health Data Information & Management System (HDIMS) Mobile App
description: Develop a mobile app enabling hospitals to enter and update health data viewable by administrators, supporting performance tracking for health schemes and policy formulation.

title: Drug Inventory and Supply Chain Tracking System
description: Create a system ensuring the right quantity of the right product reaches the right place at the right time and condition, with dashboard monitoring, vendor tracking, and consumption analysis.

title: Software for Speech Language Therapy Clinical Services
description: Develop software digitizing speech-language therapy services end-to-end, from patient allocation through progress evaluation, with therapy plan management and supervisor review workflows.

title: Carbon Footprint Quantification Tool for Indian Coal Mines
description: Create a web app helping coal mines quantify carbon emissions and explore carbon-neutrality pathways, with activity-wise emission estimation, carbon sink analysis, and renewable-energy options.

title: Building Integrated Photovoltaic (BIPV) Potential Assessment
description: Develop an interactive application assessing BIPV potential using LOD-1 3D city models from satellite data, simulating shadows and calculating incident solar energy on vertical surfaces.

title: Research, IPR, and Start-up Monitoring for Gujarat State
description: Build a web app unifying research project tracking, IPR management, innovation monitoring, and startup support, with a centralized data repository and collaboration tools.

title: Alumni Association Platform for University/Institute
description: Develop web and mobile apps facilitating alumni networking, donations, job posting, and success tracking, with registration, secure donations, an alumni directory, and event management.

title: Learning App for Deaf and Mute Students with Sign Language Converter
description: Create a mobile app teaching deaf and mute students via Indian Sign Language, with alphabet/number instruction, word/sentence translation, and speech-to-sign conversion.

title: Publications Summary Generator for Faculty Profile Building
description: Develop a solution that crawls academic databases (Google Scholar, DBLP) to generate publication summaries, with customized year-wise queries and multi-format export.

title: Learning Path Dashboard for Skill Enhancement
description: Create a dashboard enabling instructors to build learning paths with resources and track learner progress continuously, including reading statistics and mixed-media resources.

title: Smart Competency Diagnostic and Candidate Profile Score Calculator
description: Build an employment platform with AI-powered job matching and skill-gap analysis, including competency assessments, training recommendations, and resume tooling.

title: Blood Donation and Transfusion Management for Thalassemia Patients
description: Build an AI-driven system supporting Blood Warriors (a Thalassemia patient advocacy non-profit) with real-time systems connecting patients to regular blood donors, predictive models for donor availability, tracking for recurring donations, and integration with platforms like e-RaktKosh and Blood Bridge.

title: Access to Care and Support Networks for Thalassemia Patients
description: Design AI-supported solutions improving communication between Thalassemia patients and healthcare providers, enhancing patient education on disease management, and addressing data privacy/security for protecting patient and donor information.

title: AI Solutions for Real-World Clinical Challenges
description: Develop an AI solution addressing a genuine clinical problem end-to-end — technical implementation plus a credible go-to-market or adoption path — spanning areas like neuro AI diagnostics, patient-safety tooling, or health entrepreneurship.

title: Fraud Detection Using Device Intelligence
description: Build a fraud detection system using a device-intelligence platform's visitor-ID and smart signals to track multiple visitor IDs linked to a single data point (and vice versa), exposing coordinated fraud across e-commerce or social platforms.

title: Solve a UN Sustainable Development Goal with a Low-Code Platform
description: Address one of the UN's 17 Sustainable Development Goals using a low-code application platform and database, prioritizing innovation, implementation quality, and meaningful social impact.

title: Communication-Driven User Experiences with a Programmable API
description: Use a communications API platform's messaging, voice, and interactive tools to build a personalized, anticipatory user experience — for example smart notifications or interactive voice features embedded in an app.

title: Cold-Chain Monitoring to Protect Live Animal Cargo
description: Build real-time monitoring on a asset-tracking platform to prevent live animal cargo from being accidentally placed in cold storage during air transport, using geofence alerts and (as a stretch goal) text-to-speech notifications.

title: Predictive ETA Estimator for Temperature-Sensitive Pharmaceutical Shipments
description: Develop an ETA predictor for temperature-sensitive medication deliveries using live GPS tracking data, with automated arrival notifications and (as a stretch goal) map-based route visualization.

title: Medical Technology and Patient Accessibility Innovation
description: Develop solutions advancing medical technology, improving accessibility for patients with disabilities or limited resources, or advancing biotechnology research with a real-world application.

title: FinTech Tools, Fraud Detection, and Predictive Modeling
description: Create financial technology applications — fraud detection systems or predictive models — that address real-world financial challenges such as risk assessment or transaction monitoring.

title: Climate and Renewable Energy Technology
description: Build technology-based approaches to environmental problems — renewable energy innovations or eco-friendly practices — that demonstrate feasible, measurable real-world impact.

title: Wastewater Reuse Tracking Solutions
description: Design and build innovative technology solutions — using Blockchain, AI and/or IoT — that help track and verify wastewater reuse, addressing gaps identified by water-reuse utilities in monitoring and reporting reused water volumes and quality.
hackathon_name: Global Blockchain Hackathon for Clean Water

title: Email Spoofing Detection
description: Identify and flag emails with misleading sender information. The solution should detect manipulated 'From', 'Reply-To', and 'Return-Path' addresses used in phishing and business-email-compromise attacks to make malicious emails appear to come from a trusted source.

title: Fake News Detection System
description: Design a tool for tracking and tracing fake news and its origin using official sources as an input filter, with a mechanism to mitigate the spread of fake news by auto-populating spreaders' inboxes with official/authenticated content.

title: Phishing Detection Solution
description: Build an AI-enabled phishing-links detection and alert system that identifies phishing sources across web pages, email apps, social media, instant messengers, and text messages, as a desktop/mobile app or browser plugin.

title: Spam Alert System
description: Design a crowd-sourcing based solution that analyses and verifies the source of incoming calls, SMS, and emails from end-user inputs, classifying each as genuine or spam and generating a crowd-sourced risk score.

title: Layering of Bank Accounts
description: Build a mechanism that integrates different bank accounts under criminal investigation into interactive spider/virtual maps showing nodal points and money-trail movement between accounts, linkable across cases and filterable by account holder, IP, phone, or email.

title: Development of MIS Model for District Policing
description: Build a console/dashboard depicting district-level developments — FIR registration, complaint registration, and other applications — at one common point of delivery, integrable with the Bihar Police app, so senior officers can see a consolidated gist of district activity.

title: Social Media Analysis / Record Finding Tool
description: Build an open-source-intelligence platform that, given a suspect's email or mobile number, crowdsources and interconnects linked accounts across platforms such as Facebook, WhatsApp, Instagram, Twitter, Paytm, TrueCaller, Amazon, and UPI using public-domain information.

title: Crime-Based Data Collection Software
description: Build an application that ingests police investigation data (CDRs, bank accounts, IPDR) and organizes it crime-wise, alerting officers when an input number or detail matches another registered crime, retrievable by FIR/crime number with interlinkages shown.

title: Crime Predictive Model / Tool for Hotspot Mapping
description: Build an interface linking FIR data (mapped to specific IPC sections and other acts) to generate colour-coded crime hotspot zones by type, time, and season, with behavioural crime prediction, patrol-route generation, and accident-prone-area identification using IRAD/CCTNS data.

title: Regional Social Media Viral-Content Tracker
description: Build a keyword-based search tool that scans multiple social media platforms in chronological order to identify the areas, user profiles, and platforms circulating a given piece of content, returning a time chronology and details of the accounts driving its spread.

title: VoIP Calls Tracing
description: Build a solution that helps police trace the origin of internet (VoIP) calls, for example by capturing IMEI or IP-grabbing mechanisms, or tracing virtual-number details from apps used to place such calls, in order to identify the caller's location.

title: Mobile Forensics Tool
description: Build open-source-intelligence software that extracts and analyses mobile device data for criminal investigation — including scanning deleted files and crawling WhatsApp/Facebook chats — once an officer connects the phone via a data cable, returning filtered results.

title: Autonomous AI-Based Threat Detection and Elimination Engine for Ransomware & Zero-Day Attacks
description: Build an AI-powered alert-management system that automatically detects and blocks ransomware and zero-day attacks against cloud services, reducing security-analyst workload, with an analytics section that measures performance by evaluating false positives.

title: Attack Surface Monitoring Tool for Critical Systems
description: Build a fully automated, on-premises/cloud attack-surface monitoring tool that continuously discovers, analyses, and remediates cybersecurity vulnerabilities and potential attack vectors across an inventory of critical systems, with integrity/configuration checking, patch management, and standard integration APIs.

title: Voice Recognition Software to Mitigate Cyber Frauds
description: Build a voice recognition system (VRS) that lets law-enforcement agencies store, group, and match voice samples of persons of interest against noisy/distorted recordings from fraud victims, ranking near-matches by similarity to help identify suspects, usable as court evidence.

title: Securing Document Handling for Non-Tech-Savvy Users
description: Design a secure, user-friendly, traceable document-sharing and printing solution for people with limited digital literacy, balancing usability with robust security and adaptable to low-tech environments such as rural internet cafés, to minimize data breaches or misuse of sensitive documents.

title: AI-Powered Ransomware Detection and Response
description: Develop a real-time AI system that uses machine learning to identify ransomware behaviour patterns, monitors system activity and file changes, detects encryption attempts, triggers automated containment responses, and produces detailed forensic information for post-incident analysis.

title: Securing IoT Networks with Blockchain and Zero Trust Architecture
description: Design a secure IoT network-management system using blockchain for device authentication/data integrity and Zero Trust principles for continuous verification and least-privilege access, scalable to large device fleets, with secure cloud communication, efficient firmware updates, and automated anomaly response.

title: AI-Powered Web Vulnerability Scanner and Automated Patching System
description: Develop an AI-driven web vulnerability scanner that detects known and potential unknown vulnerabilities, uses machine learning to cut false positives, generates severity-rated reports with suggested fixes, and automatically patches common vulnerabilities through a user-friendly management interface.

title: AI-Enhanced DevSecOps Pipeline for Secure Web Development
description: Design an AI-enhanced DevSecOps pipeline integrating with version-control and CI/CD tools that runs automated SAST/DAST/IAST security checks at each development stage, prioritizes findings with AI to cut false positives, gives developers real-time feedback, and produces comprehensive security dashboards.

title: AI-Driven Web Application Firewall (WAF) with Adaptive Rule Generation
description: Develop an AI-driven WAF that analyses web traffic in real time, uses machine learning to distinguish normal from abnormal traffic, automatically generates and updates firewall rules against detected threats, minimizes false positives, and offers explainable-AI insight into rule decisions with manual adjustment.

title: AI-Powered Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Detection and Prevention System
description: Develop an AI-powered system that analyses inputs and outputs in real time to detect both reflected and stored XSS attempts, adapts to new evasion techniques, sanitizes/encodes unsafe data, and integrates with popular web frameworks and content-management systems.

title: IoT Device Forensics and Botnet Detection System
description: Build a system that performs remote forensic analysis on IoT devices without disrupting operation, detects compromise or botnet infection, extracts and analyses firmware for malicious modifications, monitors traffic for C2 communications, isolates compromised devices, and generates cybercrime-investigation-ready forensic reports.

title: Verified Software Download Link Checker
description: Build a tool or browser plugin that suggests and verifies correct download links for files or software, protecting users who click top search results that often lead to malicious files, by providing verified and secure download options where available.
